info.name: OpenSign Master Key API (Parse Cloud Functions)
info.description: IMPORTANT ORDER: (1) run health-check, (2) if needed run loginuser and set sessionToken, (3) call business functions. parseBaseUrl MUST include Parse mount path, e.g. https://your-host/api/app or http://localhost:8080/app

request.description: Should return JSON from Parse. If you still get HTML, parseBaseUrl is wrong or reverse proxy does not expose Parse mount.
Login to get user context; copy `result.sessionToken` to collection variable `sessionToken`. Some business APIs require user session in header `sessiontoken`.
Master Key call. For user-context APIs, enable header `sessiontoken` or `X-Parse-Session-Token` with `{{sessionToken}}`.
